source: arXiv:2602.21611v1; author code and verbatim prompts unavailable

subtask_intent.category_z: one of the four coarse categories

confirmed_from_paper.memory_entry: m=(z,d,e), where e is an abstracted success pattern or failure-avoidance experience
confirmed_from_paper.retrieval: category hard filter, cosine semantic rank, forced Top-1 without threshold/abstention, then inject e at subtask start
confirmed_from_paper.update: evaluate each completed local trajectory; extract success pattern or failure avoidance; append memory
confirmed_from_paper.streaming: empty per arm/order; target experience becomes visible only after target completion; no self-memory; extraction is accounted
confirmed_from_paper.metric: Avg. Pass@1 over frozen orders; Best@3 secondary

AR1.name: STRUCTURED_ONLY
AR1.solve_payload: current coarse category, local intent, allowed transition signals

AR2.name: INSTANCE_MEMORY
AR2.solve_payload: whole-task intent plus forced Top-1 prior completed whole-task experience
AR2.extraction: one same-reader whole-task success/failure extraction after task completion

AR3.name: AUTHOR_COARSE_SUBTASK_MEMORY
AR3.solve_payload: coarse category/local intent plus category-filtered forced Top-1 experience
AR3.memory: coarse m=(z,d,e); no semantic atom or DAG
AR3.extraction: one same-reader success/failure extraction per completed coarse category; buffered until task completion

AR4.name: NO_CATEGORY_FILTER
AR4.solve_payload: same as AR3 except global forced Top-1 over completed coarse entries
AR4.memory: coarse m=(z,d,e); no semantic atom or DAG

AR5.name: RAW_COARSE_SUBTASK_TRAJECTORY
AR5.solve_payload: AR3 category/local query and token-matched injection cap
AR5.memory: bounded raw local trajectory after same-reader success/failure classification
AR5.extraction: one classification call per completed coarse category; abstraction text is discarded

category_transitions.continuation: CONTINUE remains in the current category

online_isolation.visible_memory: strict completed-target prefix within one arm and one order
online_isolation.current_target_extractions: buffered and invisible until task completion
online_isolation.self_memory: prohibited and checked in state, retrieval, payload, result
online_isolation.resume: task checkpoint plus request/response call journal; an orphan request fails closed

reproduction_labels.AUTHOR_METHOD_REPRODUCED: AR3 > AR0 and AR2; preregistered CI/stat rule passes; no integrity failure; direction stable across frozen orders
reproduction_labels.AUTHOR_METHOD_DIRECTIONAL: point estimate positive but CI includes zero
